reconcile.note: Gill reads the ark's full stay as forty-to-fifty years until David's reign, with the twenty years of 1 Samuel 7:2 marking only the period before Israel revived and sought Yahweh.

sides.snippet: It happened, from the day that the ark abode in Kiriath Jearim, that the time was long; for it was twenty years
sides.verseText: It happened, from the day that the ark abode in Kiriath Jearim, that the time was long; for it was twenty years: and all the house of Israel lamented after Yahweh.

sides.snippet: They set the ark of God on a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in the hill
sides.verseText: They set the ark of God on a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in the hill: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.
